# 10 · The Observatory
Science tempo as identity: per-tech and per-age payoffs, age-lead as a weapon. The
per-age scaler shape is the real identity and is barely used.
Wins by: First Into the Age (every era) · The Deepest Learning · the curtain itself.

**Tech:** this theme IS the tree — Letters · Calendar (I); Mathematics · The Orrery of Bronze · The Examination Hall · Education (III); Physics · Movable Type (IV). All plain; the age-lead mechanics do the theming.

## Æra I
- Tech:
  - Letters — unlocks Library, The Great Ziggurat, Scholarship, Omen Reading
- Orders:
  - The Almanac — +2 science in your capital, and +1 science in every city with a Library.
  - Star-Gazers — +2 science in every city with a mountain hex inside its borders.
- Religion:
  - Star Readers — +3 science in every city beside a mountain.
  - Keeper of the Calendar — Every 20 turns, you are offered a find from a ruin. A ruin pays once for each age you have reached.
- Deeds:
  - First Into the Age (recurring) — The first empire in the world to reach a new age.

## Æra II
- Orders:
  - The Lyceum (a tech pays a turn of culture — the new derived grant)
  - Scholars' Stipend — +2 science in every city of 5 or more population.
- Wonders:
  - The Great Library — +1 science in every city with a Library · on completion, the technology you are researching is finished
- Deeds:
  - The Scholar's Wager — Stand two whole ages ahead of the most backward empire in the world.
  - The Library of the Realm — Hold a library and a university in four cities.

## Æra III
- Tech:
  - Education — unlocks University, The House of Wisdom, The Forbidden City
  - The Examination Hall — unlocks Examination Hall, The Examination Hall · +5 percentage points to the bonus your positive happiness pays
- Orders: ▢ ________ (a per-age scaler: +X per age you lead the median?)
- Doctrines:
  - The Encyclopaedia — +1 science for each building in a city. Science buildings cost −50% production.
- Wonders:
  - The House of Wisdom — +50% science in every city with The House of Wisdom · on completion, the technology you are researching is finished
- Deeds:
  - The Deepest Learning — At the close of the age, the empire that completed the most technologies of it.
  - The Encyclopaedia — A race. Needs a university in every city. The first empire to finish banks a great sum of learning.

## Æra IV
- Tech: ▢ ________ (what does the last science DO besides end the game — the mastery question)
- Orders: ▢ ________
- Deeds: ▢ ________ · finishing the chart as the theme's Opus

## Gaps
Mostly flat adders today; the age-lead mechanics (cost bands punish laggards) do the work
and nothing celebrates them.
